title: FOC Default Controller Gains
text: Compute controller gains for the FOC based algorithms at run time based on empirical method or optimum theory, {Block Output} sets Output of the block Current controller (d,q-axes), and so does the port count; {Motor selection} sets the type of motor, {Output unit} sets the unit of the block output, {Specify filter and sensor delays} enables addition of filter and sensor, {Current sensor delay (s)} sets the delay due to current, {Speed sensor delay (s)} sets the delay due to speed and {Speed filter delay (s)} sets the delay due to speed filtering. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: SlowdownFactor
ports.summary: Factor to slow down system response scalar in the range of [1, 20]

ports.name: p
ports.summary: Number of pole pairs available in the motor scalar

ports.name: Flux PM
ports.summary: Peak permanent magnet flux linkage scalar

ports.name: CurrLoopDelay
ports.summary: Overall time constant value for the current delay present in feedback path scalar

ports.name: SpeedLoopDelay
ports.summary: Overall time constant value for the speed delay present in feedback path scalar

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: PI gains computation status true | false

params.name: Output unit
params.values: Unit of the block output SI Unit (default) | Per-Unit

params.name: Block Output
params.values: Output of the block Current controller (d,q-axes) | Field-weakening controller | Speed controller

params.name: Specify filter and sensor delays
params.values: Enable addition of filter and sensor delays off (default) | on

params.name: Current sensor delay (s)
params.values: Delay due to current sensor 50e-6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Speed sensor delay (s)
params.values: Delay due to speed sensor 50e-6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Speed filter delay (s)
params.values: Delay due to speed filtering 0.02 (default) | scalar
